notes:
Composed of {名|めい} (fame, name) and ⟦{士|し}→〜士：28352_shi⟧ (person of quality). Implies social respectability and public recognition. Somewhat formal and slightly old-fashioned, often used in writing about local communities and social events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}: local notable
- {各界|かくかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}: distinguished figures from various fields
- {社交界|しゃこうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}: notable in high society
- {名士|めいし}{録|ろく}: who's who, register of notables

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有名人|ゆうめいじん}→有名人：17812_yuumeijin⟧: famous person, celebrity — more modern and broad
- ⟦{著名人|ちょめいじん}→著名人：23055_chomeijin⟧: prominent person — formal, used in media
- ⟦{名家|めいか}→名家：23910_meika⟧: distinguished family — refers to the family rather than the individual

definitions.explanation: a person of high social standing or distinction, known and respected in their community or field

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社交界|しゃこうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known as a notable figure in high society.

examples.japanese: {各界|かくかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名士|めいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}いて→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A party was held inviting distinguished figures from various fields.
